title: Preferential Lysis of S. rosetta for Total RNA
author: David Booth
materials: Lyse cells in preferential lysis buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Stock
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis buffer ahead of time by combining the following components for a 10 ml volume, excluding DTT, Turbo DNase, and SUPERaseIn:

substeps.instruction: Water: 0.41 ml
Tris-HCl (pH 8.0, 1 M): 200 µl (Final: 20 mM)
KCl (2 M): 750 µl (Final: 150 mM)
MgCl2 (1 M): 50 µl (Final: 5 mM)
Sucrose (1.75 M / 60% w/v): 420 µl (Final: 250 mM)
Cycloheximide (100 mg/ml): 10 µl (Final: 100 ug/ml)
Protease inhibitor tablet: 1 ml (2 mini tablets / 10 ml)
Digitonin (20 mM): 5 ml (Final: 10 mM)
Sodium Heparin (100 mg/ml): 100 µl (Final: 1 mg/ml)
Pefabloc SC (200 mM): 50 µl (Final: 1 mM)

steps.title: Aliquot and Store Buffer
steps.instruction: Split the prepared buffer into 449.5 µl aliquots and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Activate Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Just before use, thaw a 449.5 µl aliquot on ice and add the following to reach a total volume of 500 µl:

substeps.instruction: DTT (1 M): 0.5 µl
Turbo DNase (2 U/µl): 25 µl
SUPERaseIn (20 U/µl): 25 µl

steps.title: Determine Cell Concentration
steps.instruction: Calculate the concentration of cells in the culture using a hemocytometer:

substeps.instruction: Fix 200 µl of cells with 2 µl of 37% formaldehyde and vortex well.
Homogenize cells by pipetting up and down, then pipet 12 µl of cells into the chamber of a Neubauer, bright-line hemocytometer.
Count the number of cells (N) in the four corner quadrants.
Calculate cell concentration ([Cells] cells/ml) using the equation: [Cells] = N/4 * 10,000 cells/ml.

steps.title: Calculate Required Lysis Buffer Volume
steps.instruction: Determine the total number of cells and the required volume of lysis buffer:

substeps.instruction: Determine the volume of the culture (Vol).
Calculate total cells: Total = [cells] * Vol.
Calculate volume of lysis buffer to add: LysisBuffer = Total / 100,000 µl.

steps.title: Harvest S. rosetta Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cells from the culture:

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells in 50 ml conical tubes at 2400 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Gently remove supernatant with a serological pipette, leaving a small amount of liquid on the pellet.
Remove the remaining supernatant with a fine-tip transfer pipet.

steps.title: Lyse and Homogenize Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend and break down the cell pellet:

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in the previously calculated volume of LysisBuffer.
Pipet cells gently up and down and incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Homogenize the lysate by passing it 5 times through a 30G needle attached to a luer lock syringe.

steps.title: Clarify and Store Lysate
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate from debris and store:

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 6000 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Gently transfer the supernatant into a new tube using a gel-loading tip, ensuring the bacterial pellet is not disturbed.
Flash freeze the lysate in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C for long term storage.
